user.title: Connect FamFam
user.description: Paste an integration token from the FamFam app (Settings → Your Family → Connected services). One token covers your whole family.

data_description.api_token: Integration tokens are created by an organiser and shown once.
data_description.url: Leave as-is unless you are pointing at a staging or self-hosted server.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthorise FamFam
reauth_confirm.description: The token for {family_name} was revoked or is no longer valid. Create a new one in the FamFam app (Settings → Your Family → Connected services) and paste it here.

data_description.api_token: Integration tokens are created by an organiser and shown once.

abort.unique_id_mismatch: This token belongs to a different family.

data.create_member_calendars: Create a calendar for each member

data_description.poll_interval: How often to check famfam.life for changes, in seconds.
data_description.default_member: Who button presses and voice-originated actions act as. Leave empty to act as the token's member.
data_description.create_member_calendars: Adds a calendar entity for each family member.
data_description.lists: Which FamFam lists appear as to-do lists. While every list is selected, new lists appear automatically.

abort.not_loaded: FamFam is not loaded. Fix the connection first, then adjust options.

add_event.name: Add event
add_event.description: Adds a single event to the family calendar. Repeating events are created in the FamFam app.

config_entry_id.name: FamFam family
config_entry_id.description: Which family to act on. Only needed when more than one FamFam family is set up.

start.name: Start
start.description: When the event starts, in the family's timezone.

end.name: End
end.description: When the event ends. Leave empty for an event with no end time. Events can't span more than one day.

all_day.name: All day
all_day.description: Makes an all-day event on the start date.

members.name: Members
members.description: Member names or ids the event is for. Leave empty for the whole family.

calendar_entity_id.name: Calendar
calendar_entity_id.description: A FamFam calendar to add the event to — a member's calendar assigns the event to that member. Ignored when members is set.

set_dinner_checkin.name: Set dinner check-in
set_dinner_checkin.description: Answers the dinner check-in for a family member — three answers, matching the app, not an on/off toggle.

config_entry_id.name: FamFam family
config_entry_id.description: Which family to act on. Only needed when more than one FamFam family is set up.

member.name: Member
member.description: Member name or id. Leave empty to use the default member from the integration options.

date.name: Date
date.description: Defaults to today in the family's timezone.

status.name: Status
status.description: The member's answer for that day's dinner.

set_meal.name: Set meal
set_meal.description: Sets the planned meal for a date, from a recipe or as free text.

config_entry_id.name: FamFam family
config_entry_id.description: Which family to act on. Only needed when more than one FamFam family is set up.

date.name: Date
date.description: The day the meal is planned for.

recipe_id.name: Recipe id
recipe_id.description: A FamFam recipe id — find one with the search recipes action. Use either this or a meal name, not both.

meal_name.name: Meal name
meal_name.description: A free-text meal, for when there's no recipe.

add_meal_ingredients_to_list.name: Add meal ingredients to list
add_meal_ingredients_to_list.description: Sends the ingredients for planned meals to a list, using FamFam's Shop for Meals deduplication — ingredients already on the list aren't added twice.

config_entry_id.name: FamFam family
config_entry_id.description: Which family to act on. Only needed when more than one FamFam family is set up.

date_from.name: From
date_from.description: First day of planned meals to shop for.

date_to.name: To
date_to.description: Last day of planned meals to shop for. Defaults to the from date.

list_entity_id.name: List
list_entity_id.description: The FamFam list to add ingredients to. Defaults to the grocery list.

add_list_item.name: Add list item
add_list_item.description: Adds an item to a FamFam list, optionally straight into an aisle category — which the standard to-do add item action can't do.

config_entry_id.name: FamFam family
config_entry_id.description: Which family to act on. Only needed when more than one FamFam family is set up.

list_entity_id.name: List
list_entity_id.description: The FamFam list to add the item to.

item.name: Item
item.description: The item text. Quantities go in the text — for example "2L milk".

category.name: Category
category.description: The aisle grouping shown on grocery lists.

start_shopping_trip.name: Start shopping trip
start_shopping_trip.description: Announces a shopping trip to the whole family, attributed to the member the token belongs to. Trips are a FamFam Plus feature.

config_entry_id.name: FamFam family
config_entry_id.description: Which family to act on. Only needed when more than one FamFam family is set up.

end_shopping_trip.name: End shopping trip
end_shopping_trip.description: Ends the current shopping trip. Does nothing if no trip is running.

config_entry_id.name: FamFam family
config_entry_id.description: Which family to act on. Only needed when more than one FamFam family is set up.

search_recipes.name: Search recipes
search_recipes.description: Searches the family's recipes and returns the matches as response data. All filters are optional and combine.

config_entry_id.name: FamFam family
config_entry_id.description: Which family to act on. Only needed when more than one FamFam family is set up.

query.name: Search text
query.description: Matches against recipe names and ingredients.

cuisine.name: Cuisine
cuisine.description: A cuisine the recipe must have.

diet.name: Diet
diet.description: A diet the recipe must suit.

free_from.name: Free from
free_from.description: An allergen the recipe must be free from.

course.name: Course
course.description: A course the recipe must have.

get_meal_plan.name: Get meal plan
get_meal_plan.description: Returns the planned meals as response data, starting from today in the family's timezone.

config_entry_id.name: FamFam family
config_entry_id.description: Which family to act on. Only needed when more than one FamFam family is set up.

days.name: Days
days.description: How many days to include, starting today. FamFam provides up to 14.

setup_auth_failed.message: The FamFam token was rejected. Reauthorise the integration with a new token.

setup_connect_failed.message: Could not reach FamFam to set up the integration.

update_failed.message: Could not fetch the latest data from FamFam.

item_not_found.message: That item no longer exists on the FamFam list.

event_not_found.message: That event no longer exists on the FamFam calendar.

event_quota_exceeded.message: Your family has reached its FamFam event limit for the moment.

event_not_creator.message: Only the person who created this event can change or delete it.

event_recurrence_not_supported.message: Repeating events can't be created from Home Assistant — create them in the FamFam app.

event_recurring_edit_not_supported.message: Repeating events can't be edited from Home Assistant — edit them in the FamFam app.

event_occurrence_not_supported.message: Only the whole series can be deleted from Home Assistant — manage single occurrences in the FamFam app.

event_multi_day_not_supported.message: FamFam events can't span more than one day.

trip_start_failed.message: FamFam couldn't start the shopping trip ({code}).

trip_plus_required.message: Shopping trip announcements need a FamFam Plus subscription.

trip_already_active.message: A shopping trip is already running — end it in the FamFam app first.

trip_end_failed.message: FamFam couldn't end the shopping trip ({code}).

checkin_set_failed.message: FamFam couldn't save the dinner check-in ({code}).

checkin_organiser_only.message: Only an organiser's token can answer the dinner check-in for another family member.

ingredients_add_failed.message: FamFam couldn't add the meal ingredients to the list ({code}).

item_limit_reached.message: That FamFam list is full for your plan — check off or delete some items first.

no_list_access.message: The token's member doesn't have access to that FamFam list.

member_not_found_server.message: FamFam doesn't recognise that family member — they may have left the family.

rate_limited.message: FamFam is asking Home Assistant to slow down — try again in a minute.

service_not_configured.message: FamFam is not set up yet — add the integration first.

service_entry_not_found.message: No FamFam family matches that config entry id.

service_entry_not_loaded.message: FamFam is not loaded — fix the connection first, then try again.

service_multiple_families.message: More than one FamFam family is set up — pass config_entry_id to say which one.

service_entry_mismatch.message: The chosen entity belongs to a different FamFam family than the given config entry id.

entity_not_famfam.message: {entity_id} is not a FamFam entity of the right kind for this action.

list_entity_invalid.message: {entity_id} doesn't map to a FamFam list any more — pick a current list entity.

calendar_entity_invalid.message: Events can't be added to that calendar — pick a member calendar or the family calendar.

grocery_list_unresolved.message: Couldn't work out which list is the grocery list — pass a list entity.

member_required.message: Pass a member, or set a default member in the FamFam options.

member_ambiguous.message: More than one family member is called "{member}" — use their member id instead.

date_range_invalid.message: The end must not be before the start.

date_range_too_long.message: The date range must span {max_days} days or fewer.
